name: list_workspaces
description: List all workspaces for the authenticated user

name: create_workspace
description: DISABLED — Agents must not create their own workspaces. Use list_workspaces to find the user's existing workspace. This tool always returns an error directing agents to use the user's workspace.

name: list_templates
description: List templates with optional workspace filter and search

name: get_template
description: Get a template by ID with full canvas data, frames, styles, variables

name: create_template
description: Create a new design template in a workspace. ALWAYS pass engine='html'. For designs from Gemini/ChatGPT/Claude (complete HTML+CSS), use import_design instead — it auto-parses the document and handles everything in one call. For editable component designs, create the empty template and call set_frame_layers. Returns template with .id and .frames[0].id.

engine.description: Rendering engine (default 'html'). Use 'html' for code-based designs.

html.description: Initial HTML content (HTML engine only). If provided, body { width/height } in CSS will be auto-synced to match width/height parameters.

css.description: Initial CSS styles (HTML engine only). body dimensions are auto-corrected to match width/height params — no need to manually set them.

allowGroupedLayers.description: Set true only when groups/components are intentional. Default false rejects grouped raw HTML.

name: create_html_carousel
description: Create one multi-frame HTML carousel at custom dimensions in a single validated call. Use this for social carousels and any multi-frame design that is not a 1920x1080 presentation. Frames are persisted side by side with exactly the requested width and height.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID to create the carousel in

width.description: Width of every frame, from 1 to 10000 pixels

height.description: Height of every frame, from 1 to 10000 pixels

brandId.description: Optional saved brand guideline to link and copy onto the template

frames.description: All carousel frames. Every frame must contain final, substantial HTML and CSS.

name: create_deck
description: Create a complete 1920x1080 presentation deck in ONE call. The generated cover is always the first frame, so total frames = 1 cover + slides.length. Use create_html_carousel instead for social or custom dimensions. Deterministic scaffolding places frames side by side, adds page numbering, and keeps title/body fonts consistent. CSS vars available in slide css: --deck-brand, --deck-bg, --deck-ink, --deck-muted, --deck-title-font, --deck-body-font. Returns templateId + editorUrl.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID to create the deck in

brandId.description: Optional saved brand guideline. Its sharedCss is inserted into every generated frame.

color.description: Corporate color hex, e.g. #0A4B3E (cover background + accents)

cover.description: Optional free cover composition (background stays the corporate color)

slides.description: Content slides after the generated cover. A 3-frame deck therefore requires exactly 2 entries here. title is placed deterministically; html/css is your free composition inside the 1728x760 content zone.

html.description: Free HTML composition for the content zone

css.description: CSS for your composition (scoped per frame)

name: update_template
description: Update template metadata or raw HTML/CSS. For importing complete designs (from Gemini, etc.), use import_design instead. For editable component designs, use set_frame_layers. Raw html/frames require flat editability contract. Set allowGroupedLayers=true only for intentional groups/components.

canvas.description: Canvas JSON with objects and viewport (legacy)

html.description: HTML content for active frame (HTML engine)

css.description: CSS styles for active frame (HTML engine)

frames.description: Full frames array with html/css for each frame (HTML engine)

allowGroupedLayers.description: Allow explicitly declared group/container/component layers. Default false.

name: delete_template
description: Permanently delete a template

name: duplicate_template
description: Create an independent copy of a template

name: export_template
description: Export a template as .futuraria JSON for backup/migration

name: import_template
description: Import a .futuraria JSON export into a workspace

data.description: The .futuraria JSON object (must have format: 'futuraria/v1' and template.name)

name: import_svg
description: Import SVG content (string or URL) and convert into an editable HTML frame. Parses SVG elements (rect, circle, path, text, polygon, line) and maps them to positioned HTML/CSS with data-layer-id attributes. Creates a new template with one frame containing the result.

svg.description: Raw SVG content as a string

url.description: URL to fetch SVG from (alternative to svg)

name: render_batch
description: Render multiple templates to HTML+PNG in one call. Returns render URLs for each.

templateIds.description: List of template IDs to render

transparent.description: Render with transparent background instead of white (default false)

name: list_versions
description: List all saved versions of a template for undo/restore

name: restore_version
description: Restore a template to a previously saved version. The current state is snapshotted first, so a restore can itself be undone.

name: list_snapshots
description: List in-memory auto-snapshots of a template (newest first): id, type (ia|human|system), trigger, timestamp, frameCount. Pass an id to restore_version's versionId to roll back. Warm-invocation only — durable history is list_versions.

name: save_version
description: Save the design's current state as a permanent version in the history. Call this BEFORE making a batch of edits so the previous state can be restored and diffed.

label.description: Short description, e.g. 'antes de aplicar la nueva paleta'

author.description: Who is saving, e.g. 'agent:lara' or 'agent:claude-opus-5'. Defaults to agent:mcp.

name: diff_versions
description: Show WHAT changed between two versions of a design, frame by frame, returning the before and after HTML/CSS. Use after get_frame_changes tells you a frame changed and you need to understand the human's edit. Omit 'toVersionId' to compare a stored version against the design as it is right now.

toVersionId.description: Version to compare against. Omit to compare with the CURRENT live design.

frameId.description: Limit the diff to one frame

includeUnchanged.description: Include frames whose content is identical (default false)

name: list_fonts
description: List fonts used in a template with usage counts, sizes, and weights

name: create_frame
description: Create a frame (artboard) inside a template for grouping/containing objects

parentFrameId.description: Optional parent frame ID for nested frames

name: list_frames
description: List all frames in a template

name: get_frame
description: Get a single frame by ID

name: delete_frame
description: Delete a frame and all its contained objects

name: set_animation
description: Set or edit a frame's animation — the single JSON source of truth (timeline + clips + tweens + transitions) that compiles to WAAPI preview in the editor and to browser-side video export. Sanitized with normalizeAnimation (never throws on partial input). Shortcut: pass presetIds + presetLayerId to apply catalog presets instead of a full schema. Pass clear:true to remove the animation.

animation.description: AnimationSchema: {timeline:{durationSec,fps,width,height,loop:'once'|'loop'|'pingpong'}, clips:[{layerId,startSec,endSec,tweens:[{prop,keyframes:[{t:0..1,value}],easing}]}], transitions:[{toFrameId,type:'fade'|'slide'|'zoom'|'wipe',durationSec}]}. Keyframe t is normalized WITHIN each clip window.

presetIds.description: Shortcut: animation preset ids (see list_animation_presets) applied in order to presetLayerId, on top of the existing schema (or a fresh default one).

presetLayerId.description: Layer id the presetIds apply to (must exist in the frame html as data-layer-id)

windowSec.description: Optional clip window for presets: {startSec, endSec} (default: 0..min(1.2, duration))

durationSec.description: Convenience timeline patcher: total duration in seconds (0.2-600)

name: get_animation
description: Read a frame's animation schema plus a summary (stats): clips per layer, timeline, transitions. hasAnimation:false means the frame is static.

name: list_animation_presets
description: Catalog of animation presets (fade-in, slide-in, zoom-in, pop, float, typewriter, ...), easing presets (incl. spring(damping,stiffness)) and animatable props. Use before set_animation to pick preset ids, easings and prop names.

name: apply_transition
description: Set how THIS frame hands over to the next frame in the exported video: fade | slide | zoom | wipe. Lives on the from-frame's animation; replaces any existing transition to the same target frame.

toFrameId.description: Next frame the transition leads to

name: search_google_fonts
description: Search and browse 94 Google Fonts by name or category (sans-serif, serif, display, handwriting, monospace). Returns family name, category, available weight variants, and the Google Fonts CSS URL. Use this to discover fonts for your designs before applying via add_text fontFamily or transform_object fontFamily.

search.description: Search by font name or category (e.g. 'play', 'serif', 'mono')

name: preview_font
description: Render a font preview on the canvas showing the font family name at large size and a sample pangram in that typeface.

name: ai_generate_text
description: Generate AI text content using OpenRouter (GPT-4o-mini). Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var. Optionally adds generated text to canvas.

templateId.description: Optional template ID to add generated text to

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt (default: 'You are a design assistant')

name: ai_generate_image
description: Generate or edit an image with Google's Nano Banana models (Gemini native image generation). Prompt-only creates a new image from scratch; pass imageBase64 to EDIT that image guided by the prompt. Needs a Google Gemini API key — the SAME key as image_to_design: passed as geminiApiKey, the user's BYOK key, or GEMINI_API_KEY on the server.

prompt.description: What to generate, or how to edit the reference image

imageBase64.description: Optional reference image (data URI or raw base64). With it the model edits that image; without it a new image is generated from scratch

model.description: Nano Banana model: gemini-3.1-flash-image (default), gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-2.5-flash-image

aspectRatio.description: Optional output aspect ratio like 1:1, 4:3, 9:16, 16:9 (from-scratch generations; default is the model's own)

geminiApiKey.description: Optional caller-supplied Google Gemini API key (used for this request only, never stored)

name: ai_palette
description: Generate a color palette (5-7 colors) based on a theme, mood, or description using AI. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

theme.description: Theme or description for the palette (e.g. 'ocean sunset', 'corporate tech', 'warm minimal')

name: ai_suggest_layout
description: Analyze the current template canvas and suggest layout improvements (alignment, spacing, hierarchy). Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

name: ai_translate
description: Translate text on the canvas or supplied text to another language using AI. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

templateId.description: Template ID whose text objects to translate

targetLayerName.description: Specific layer to translate (optional; translates all text objects if omitted)

text.description: Direct text to translate (alternative to templateId+layer)

name: separate_image_layers
description: Submit a Seedream 5.0 Pro (WaveSpeedAI) layer-decomposition task: splits ONE image into a base image + up to 16 transparent layers (median ~77s). ASYNC — returns a predictionId immediately; poll it with separate_image_layers_check until status 'completed'. Key resolution: wavespeedApiKey param → user's BYOK key (provider 'wavespeed') → WAVESPEED_API_KEY env.

imageUrl.description: Public PNG/JPEG URL of the image to decompose

prompt.description: Optional: describe the desired layers/targets/grouping. Empty = automatic element detection

wavespeedApiKey.description: Optional caller-supplied WaveSpeedAI API key (used for this request only, never stored)

name: separate_image_layers_check
description: Poll a separate_image_layers task. Returns { status } while processing ('created'/'processing') or { status: 'completed', outputs: [image URLs], layers: [{ url, name, size, boundingBox }] } when done — first entry is the base/background image (full canvas, no box), the rest are transparent element crops; boundingBox.normalized is [x0,y0,x1,y1] on a 0-1000 canvas scale (absolute = output px) and locates each element so the original composition can be rebuilt at exact positions/sizes. Terminal failures throw. Also polls any other WaveSpeedAI prediction id. Free — never counted against the workspace monthly quota.

predictionId.description: The prediction/task id returned by separate_image_layers

wavespeedApiKey.description: Optional caller-supplied WaveSpeedAI API key (used for this request only, never stored)

name: generate_image_video
description: Submit a RunwayML image-to-video task (Gen-4 / Gen-4.5): animates ONE image into a 2-10s mp4 (median 1-3 min). ASYNC — returns a taskId immediately; poll it with generate_image_video_check until status 'completed'. Key resolution: runwayApiKey param → user's BYOK key (provider 'runway') → RUNWAY_API_KEY env.

imageUrl.description: Public PNG/JPEG URL of the image to animate

prompt.description: Optional motion description (what moves, camera move, style). Empty = model's best guess

model.description: Runway model id: gen4_turbo (default, ~$0.25/5s) or gen4.5 (max quality, ~$0.50/5s)

duration.description: Clip length in seconds: any integer 2-10 (default 5). Runway caps every generation at 10s — for longer pieces, generate scenes separately

runwayApiKey.description: Optional caller-supplied RunwayML API key (used for this request only, never stored)

name: generate_image_video_check
description: Poll a generate_image_video / generate_text_video task. Without persist: returns { status } while processing ('PENDING'/'THROTTLED'/'RUNNING'), { status: 'POLL_ERROR' } on transient hiccups (429/5xx — retry, don't abort), or { status: 'SUCCEEDED', tempUrl } when the video is ready. With persist:true (call ONCE after SUCCEEDED, optionally passing tempUrl to skip the status GET): downloads the mp4 and returns { status: 'completed', videoUrl, persistent } — persistent:true means it was re-uploaded to the design-assets bucket (Runway's own output URLs expire); on persistence failure persistent:false and the temporary URL is returned with a warning. Terminal failures throw. Free — never counted against the workspace monthly quota.

taskId.description: The task id returned by generate_image_video

persist.description: true = download the finished mp4 into the workspace bucket (heavy; call once after SUCCEEDED)

tempUrl.description: Optional SUCCEEDED tempUrl from a previous check — skips the status GET in persist mode

workspaceId.description: Workspace to file the video asset under (bucket path prefix)

runwayApiKey.description: Optional caller-supplied RunwayML API key (used for this request only, never stored)

name: generate_text_video
description: Submit a RunwayML text-to-video task (Gen-4 / Gen-4.5): generates a 2-10s mp4 from a text prompt ALONE — no input image, the model invents the whole scene. Describe subject, setting, motion, camera move and style. ASYNC — returns a taskId immediately; poll it with generate_image_video_check until status 'completed'. Key resolution: runwayApiKey param → user's BYOK key (provider 'runway') → RUNWAY_API_KEY env.

prompt.description: REQUIRED. Full scene description: subject, setting, motion, camera move, style/lighting. The more concrete, the better the video

model.description: Runway model id: gen4_turbo (default, fastest ~$0.05/s) or gen4.5 (max quality ~$0.10/s)

duration.description: Clip length in seconds: any integer 2-10 (default 5). Runway caps every generation at 10s — for longer pieces, generate scenes separately

runwayApiKey.description: Optional caller-supplied RunwayML API key (used for this request only, never stored)

name: create_variable
description: Create a design token variable (color, number, string) that can be bound to layer properties and reused across templates.

value.description: Variable value (hex for color, number as string for number, any string for string)

collectionId.description: Optional collection ID to group this variable

name: link_variable
description: Bind a design token variable to a layer property, so the property value tracks the variable.

targetLayerName.description: Layer name to bind the variable to

frameId.description: Optional frame ID for layer lookup

name: export_batch
description: Batch export frames or layers as PNG/SVG with configurable presets (scale, suffix, format). Renders via the render pipeline.

frameIds.description: Frame IDs to export (exports all frames if omitted)

scale.description: Scale multiplier (1, 2, 3). Overridden by format suffix.

name: copy_as
description: Copy a layer or selection as code: SVG markup, CSS styles, or JSON representation. Useful for developer handoff.

targetLayerName.description: Layer name to export as code

frameId.description: Optional frame ID for layer lookup

name: export_pdf
description: Export the entire template or specific frames as a PDF document via the render pipeline.

frameIds.description: Frame IDs to include (all frames if omitted)

name: color_picker
description: Color utilities: parse hex/rgba/hsl, generate complementary/analogous/triadic palettes, create light-dark shade gradients. Pure computation, no canvas required.

color.description: Hex color (#cba6f7, #cba6f7ff, cba6f7) or rgb/rgba string

steps.description: Number of steps for shades/gradient (default 5, max 20)

name: register_tool
description: Register a custom MCP tool (plugin) dynamically. Third-party tools can extend the MCP server with new functionality. Tools are validated and added to the runtime tool registry.

name.description: Unique tool name (must start with plugin_ prefix)

handler.description: Handler endpoint URL (webhook) that will receive tool calls

secret.description: Optional shared secret for webhook authentication

name: auth_token
description: Create a Personal Access Token (PAT) for API authentication. Tokens support scoped permissions (read, write, admin) and optional expiry. Used for headless API access and CI/CD pipelines.

userId.description: User ID to create token for

name: skill_clone
description: Create a reusable clone skill from extracted or manually-defined patterns. Stored in tpl.metadata.clonedSkills[] array. Skills can be applied later via skill_apply.

templateId.description: Template ID to store the skill on

skillName.description: Name for the cloned skill (e.g. 'Brutalist Dark Theme')

description.description: Description of what this skill captures

patterns.description: Patterns object from skill_extract, or manually defined patterns with palette/typography/spacing/layout/effects/ratios

rules.description: Design rules extracted (e.g. 'use sans-serif for headings', 'maintain 8px grid')

sourceTemplateId.description: Which template these patterns were extracted from (for provenance)

name: observe_session
description: Record and analyze human design sessions to extract workflow patterns. Actions: 'start' begins recording, 'stop' finalizes and saves, 'analyze' extracts patterns (most-used tools, typical workflow, common adjustments). Stored in global in-memory session store.

action.description: Session action: start recording, stop and save, or analyze patterns

event.description: Record a single event during session (mcpTool, canvasAction, navigation)

name: smart_layout
description: Apply advanced layout algorithms to objects: grid (row/column math), masonry (column-based with height tracking), golden-ratio (spiral positioning), circular (polar coordinates), zigzag (alternating offsets), flex-wrap (row-based with overflow). Rearranges objects automatically.

targetLayerNames.description: Layer names to arrange (all if empty)

maxWidth.description: Max row width for flex-wrap (default canvas width)

name: suggest_color_palette
description: Generate color palettes using color theory rules from a base hex color. Types: complementary (180°), analogous (±30°), triadic (±120°), monochromatic (varied S/L), split-complementary, tetradic. Uses existing rgbToHsl/hslToRgb helpers.

count.description: Number of colors to generate (2-8, default depends on type)

name: create_html_template
description: Create a new HTML/CSS design template with optional initial HTML and CSS

name: set_html
description: Replace the HTML content of a frame. Prefer import_design for importing complete designs (Gemini/ChatGPT/Claude output) — it handles the full document in one call. Use set_html only when you need to update HTML independently from CSS. Server-side sanitized with DOMPurify.

frameId.description: Optional frame ID. If omitted, writes to the first frame.

name: set_css
description: Replace the CSS stylesheet of a frame. Prefer import_design for importing complete designs (Gemini/ChatGPT/Claude output) — it handles the full document in one call. Use set_css only when you need to update CSS independently from HTML. A layer has a fill and a stroke and no background: set_paint picks the right property for you (background-color on a div, fill on an SVG shape, color on a text) and on a group paints every object inside rather than a box behind them.

frameId.description: Optional frame ID. If omitted, writes to the first frame.

name: get_template_structure
description: Parse an HTML template and return its DOM tree, CSS rules, and element list

name: select_element
description: Get details about a specific element by its data-layer-id

name: update_element
description: Update an HTML element's content or CSS rules by its data-layer-id A layer has a fill and a stroke and no background: set_paint picks the right property for you (background-color on a div, fill on an SVG shape, color on a text) and on a group paints every object inside rather than a box behind them.

elementId.description: data-layer-id of the element to update

css.description: CSS properties to set on the element (e.g. 'color: red; font-size: 24px')

name: add_element
description: Add one independent HTML layer. REQUIRES frameId. Keep parentSelector='body' for normal design objects and give the layer explicit position/left/top/width/height in css. Prefer set_frame_layers when creating several objects; nesting is reserved for intentional components/groups. A layer has a fill and a stroke and no background: set_paint picks the right property for you (background-color on a div, fill on an SVG shape, color on a text) and on a group paints every object inside rather than a box behind them.

parentSelector.description: CSS selector of the parent element (or 'body' for root)

tag.description: HTML tag name (div, span, h1, p, img, etc.)

css.description: Inline CSS styles for the element

position.description: Insertion position relative to parent (default append)

frameId.description: REQUIRED for HTML-engine templates. Frame ID to add to. Call create_html_frame first if no frames exist.

name: add_primitive
description: Add a visual primitive (rectangle, circle, or text block) to a specific frame in an HTML template. Creates the element with a data-layer-id and matching CSS rule using attribute selectors, following the visual-first design model.

frameId.description: Frame ID to add the primitive to

type.description: Primitive type: rect (rectangle), circle, or text block

x.description: X position in pixels within the frame

y.description: Y position in pixels within the frame

width.description: Width in pixels (default 200 for rect, 150 for circle)

height.description: Height in pixels (default 150 for rect, 150 for circle)

color.description: Background color (default #3B82F6 for rect, #EF4444 for circle)

content.description: Text content (only for text type, default 'Text')

borderRadius.description: Custom border-radius (default 8px for rect, 50% for circle)

name: set_frame_layers
description: RECOMMENDED tool for AI-generated designs. Replaces one frame with a flat array of independently editable sibling layers. Every text, image, button, SVG, bezier, and shape must be a separate layer with its own id, semantic name, kind, x, y, width, and height. The harness deterministically creates data-layer attributes and absolute CSS; it never invents groups or tries to ungroup generated HTML. A layer has a fill and a stroke and no background: set_paint picks the right property for you (background-color on a div, fill on an SVG shape, color on a text) and on a group paints every object inside rather than a box behind them.

fontImports.description: Optional HTTPS font stylesheet URLs. Existing @imports are preserved.

layers.description: Flat paint order from back to front. Later entries appear above earlier entries in Layers and on canvas.

name.description: Human-readable Layers name, e.g. Hero title

text.description: Plain text for text/button layers. Never send nested HTML.

svg.description: One SVG root for svg/bezier layers; the SVG remains one independent layer

style.description: Extra CSS properties. Layout properties are controlled by x/y/width/height.

name: set_canvas_layers
description: Create independently editable objects on the document canvas, outside every frame. Use this for working assets, copy, images, SVGs, and shapes that should remain visible in the editor but must not appear in frame exports. Every object is persisted with frameId=null; no visible 'unframed' label is added.

layers.description: Root canvas paint order from back to front.

name: change_element_tag
description: Change the HTML tag of an existing element (semantic tagging). The element keeps its data-layer-id, styles, and content. Use this to apply semantic meaning (e.g. change div to nav, h1, button, etc.) after creating visual primitives.

newTag.description: New HTML tag (e.g. h1, button, nav, section, p, a, etc.)

name: remove_element
description: Remove an HTML element by data-layer-id. Pass frameId for a framed layer; omit it for a root canvas object or legacy top-level HTML.

frameId.description: Optional frame ID. Omit for root canvas objects.

elementId.description: data-layer-id of the element to remove

name: reorder_element
description: Change the position of an element within its parent

elementId.description: data-layer-id of the element to move

newIndex.description: New zero-based index position within the parent

name: get_css_variables
description: Extract all CSS custom properties (variables) from a template's stylesheet

name: set_css_variable
description: Set or update a CSS custom property value in the template's stylesheet

value.description: New value for the CSS variable (e.g. '#FF0000')

name: analyze_template_structure
description: Analyze template html/css to detect layout type, colors, typography, components, and dimensions

name: extract_variables
description: Extract replaceable content (texts, images, colors, fixed sections) from template

name: apply_variables
description: Apply variable replacements directly to an existing template

name: save_recipe
description: Analyze template structure and save as a reusable recipe in Supabase

name: batch_render_html
description: Render multiple HTML templates to PNG

name: assemble_template
description: Merge all section html/css into a complete template

name: get_active_agents
description: List agents currently editing this template

name: subscribe_template
description: Subscribe to Supabase Realtime changes for a template

name: unsubscribe_template
description: Unsubscribe from template realtime channel

name: broadcast_section_change
description: Broadcast a section change via Supabase Realtime

name: claim_section
description: Claim a section/frame for exclusive editing (soft lock, 60s TTL). Returns 409 if already claimed by another agent.

name: release_section

description: Register a brand with colors, fonts, logo, spacing rules
