description: Validate template against brand rules and return compliance report

name: check_contrast
description: Calculate WCAG contrast ratios for all text elements

name: check_accessibility
description: Score template accessibility and list issues with WCAG references

name: auto_fix_brand
description: Automatically fix colors, fonts, and spacing to match brand

name: get_brands
description: List all saved brands with colors, fonts, and metadata, scoped to one workspace

name: get_brand_graph
description: Returns the brand hierarchy tree for the Red de Marcas force-directed graph (workspace → brands → Design System / Plantillas / Assets / Archivos → items)

name: get_brand_playbook
description: Queryable digest of ONE brand's design logic: design system (color/font tokens + style fingerprint), full file inventory (category, campaign, content kind) and the subset of files that are replicable for another brand. This is the tool for 'revisá toda la lógica que hicimos para la marca X' — get_brand_graph returns the visual tree instead, this returns data a model can act on.

brandName.description: Brand name — matched case-insensitive when the ID is unknown

name: replicate_brand_strategy
description: Clones brand A's design logic onto brand B: builds A's playbook (files, campaigns, design system), checks B has a design system (queues an extraction card first if not) and creates one Kanban card per A replicable file — each card tells the pipeline to rebuild that design with B's identity. Cards land in backlog tagged ['replica', 'brand:<B>', 'from:<sourceTpl>'] (idempotent: already-replicated sources are skipped) so the Musa batch or agents process them. dryRun:true previews the plan without creating anything. Recommended flow: get_brand_playbook on the source brand first.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (both brands must live here)

sourceBrandId.description: Brand to replicate FROM — accepts brand ID or name

targetBrandId.description: Brand to replicate ONTO — accepts brand ID or name

maxCards.description: Max cards to create (default 15, cap 30) — remaining sources are reported as skippedByLimit

dryRun.description: Preview the plan (cards + briefs) without creating anything

name: apply_brand
description: Apply a saved brand's colors and fonts as CSS custom properties to a template

name: detect_structure
description: Detect layout regions (hero, headline, body, cta) from template

name: adapt_format
description: Adapt template to a new format/size maintaining content

name: adapt_all_formats
description: Adapt template to multiple format sizes at once

name: compare_adaptations
description: Compare multiple format adaptations side by side

name: render_html_template
description: Render an HTML template to PNG/WebP/JPG format

name: render_to_formats
description: Render template to multiple formats at once

name: export_frame
description: Export a frame as SVG (native, importable into Figma/Illustrator) or PDF. For PNG, use render_html_template.

frameId.description: Frame ID (omit to export all frames)

name: get_design_system
description: Read the full design system (tokens, components, brand, frames) before designing. Returns JSON + CSS :root block with all design tokens, component inventory, and frame metadata.

name: lint_design
description: Run quality heuristics on a frame's HTML/CSS. Returns score (0-100), issues with severity, and layout-specific rules. Adapts to frame's layoutMode (fixed vs responsive).

frameId.description: Frame ID to lint (lints all frames if omitted)

name: export_design_tokens
description: Export design tokens as CSS :root block and/or DTCG JSON (Design Tokens Community Group format). For Figma, Storybook, or design system portability.

name: generate_design_artifacts
description: Deterministically extract DESIGN.md, tokens.json, and shared.css from the actual frame HTML/CSS. No AI summarization — pure code extraction. Returns colors, typography, spacing, components, images, and constraint facts.

action.description: extract=raw data only, generate=full artifacts (DESIGN.md+tokens.json+shared.css), publish=generate+store on template AND brand_guidelines (default: generate)

brandName.description: When publishing, save artifacts as a Brand Guideline with this name. If a brand with this exact name already exists in the workspace it's updated (refined); otherwise a new one is created. Use the convention BrandName_Purpose (e.g. Futuraria_SocialMedia, Futuraria_BrandGuidelines) — never the source frame or template's own name, since that collides across unrelated captures.

frameIds.description: Optional: scope extraction to just these frame IDs instead of every frame in the template. Use this when the user selected specific frame(s) to capture a style from.

name: extract_design_system
description: Analyze one or more templates and extract a complete design system deterministically. Multi-template: merges color palettes, typography, spacing, radii, shadows across all templates. Fills missing semantic colors (success green, warning amber, error red, info blue) derived from the palette. Discovers structural components: rounded rect+text→button, img+heading+p→card, input→form field. Falls back to palette-defaults when nothing found. Outputs full extraction with DTCG tokens, shared.css, and brand manual. Zero AI opinion — same input → same output every time. Frame selection: NO frameIds → style of ALL frames merged (use when the user only names the file); frameIds → style of ONLY those frames (use when the user names file + frame).

templateIds.description: Template IDs to analyze. Multiple templates = merged unified design system.

frameIds.description: Optional: extract ONLY these frames (frame id or frame name, case-insensitive). Omit to merge the style of ALL frames.

name.description: Name for the extracted design system (defaults to first template name)

name: verify_design_system
description: Verify extracted design tokens against actual frame content. Checks for orphan tokens (extracted but unused), missing tokens (used but not in extraction), font usage consistency, and color role classification accuracy. Returns a verification report with pass/fail/warn items.

name: generate_brand_manual
description: Generate a comprehensive brand identity manual in HTML format. Extracts colors, typography, spacing, components, and assets from the template, then produces a polished, printable brand guide with color swatches, type scale showcase, spacing reference, and component library.

templateId.description: Template ID to generate the brand manual from

brandName.description: Brand name for the cover page (defaults to template name)

name: get_design_artifacts
description: Retrieve stored design artifacts (DESIGN.md, tokens.json, shared.css) for a template. Auto-generates if not yet created. Includes staleness check (sourceHash) to detect if frames changed since last generation.

name: duplicate_frame
description: Duplicate an existing frame exactly (HTML, CSS, dimensions, layoutMode). Returns the new frame ID. Use with update_frame_content to swap text/images in the copy.

name: update_frame_content
description: Surgically update a specific element inside a frame by CSS selector. Uses cheerio for deterministic DOM patching. Supports: text replacement, innerHTML swap, src/href/className changes, arbitrary attributes (attr), style overrides, backgroundImage swap, and element removal.

selector.description: CSS selector within the frame HTML (e.g. 'img.hero', 'h1', '.cta')

backgroundImage.description: Set background-image URL (pass the URL, wraps in url())

attr.description: HTML attributes to set on the element (e.g. { 'data-slot': 'headline', alt: 'Photo' }). Pass null as value to remove the attribute.

name: get_frame_changes
description: Detect which frames changed since a known hash. The AI passes its last-known sourceHash or per-frame hashes, and gets back what changed with attribution (human vs agent). Enables iterative co-editing without stale overwrites.

frameHashes.description: Map of frameId → last-known contentHash for per-frame checking

name: optimize_image
description: Optimize image to WebP with configurable quality and max width

name: list_assets
description: List uploaded assets for a template or workspace

name: replace_asset
description: Replace an image src in template HTML with a new URL

name: search_stock_image
description: Search for stock images via Unsplash/Pexels API

name: generate_from_prompt
description: Generate an HTML/CSS template from a text prompt using AI

name: enhance_template
description: Modify/enhance a template following a natural language instruction

name: image_to_design
description: Convert an image (base64) into HTML/CSS using AI vision and inject it into a frame. Defaults to the first frame. Needs a Google Gemini API key — either passed as geminiApiKey, or configured server-side as GEMINI_API_KEY.

templateId.description: Template ID to inject the design into

frameId.description: Optional frame ID. If omitted, writes to the first frame.

width.description: Target width in px (default: image aspect ratio, fallback 1080)

height.description: Target height in px (default: image aspect ratio, fallback 1080)

geminiApiKey.description: Optional GOOGLE GEMINI API key to use for this call (takes precedence over the server's). This is NOT the chat's LLM key — a DeepSeek/OpenAI key will not work against Gemini's endpoint.

geminiModel.description: Optional Gemini model ID (default: gemini-3.7-flash). Vision-capable text models only — image-generation models (Nano Banana) cannot write code.

name: add_font_to_template
description: Add a Google Font to template CSS with @import and suggested snippet

name: get_font_details
description: Get font metadata including variants, subsets, and CSS import URL

name: search_icons
description: Search icons by name/keyword/category across multiple MIT-licensed libraries (Phosphor, Lucide, Tabler, plus Simple Icons for brand/social logos) for variety. NEVER use an emoji character as a substitute for an icon in a design — always search here first and insert the real result with insert_icon. Returns icon names to pass to insert_icon (not raw HTML — insert_icon embeds it as a real inline <svg>, which is the only reliable way to ship an icon in an exported design).

search.description: Search by icon name or keyword (e.g. 'heart', 'arrow', 'settings')

category.description: Filter by category ('brands' only applies to library: simple-icons)

library.description: Icon library (default: phosphor). simple-icons is brand/social logos, not general UI icons.

style.description: Icon weight/style — valid values depend on the library (default: each library's default)

name: insert_icon
description: Insert an icon into a frame as a real inline <svg> layer (data-layer-kind="svg") — a first-class editable vector shape, not a webfont glyph, so it always renders in exports/PNG/PDF with no external CDN dependency. Returns the layerId of the inserted element.

icon.description: Icon name without prefix (e.g. 'heart', 'rocket-launch'). Use search_icons to find names.

style.description: Icon weight/style — valid values depend on the library

name: get_icon_svg
description: Returns a single icon's real SVG source (same pipeline as insert_icon) WITHOUT writing it into any template — for a caller that needs the raw markup itself, e.g. to place it as a standalone canvas object outside any frame.

name.description: Icon name. Use search_icons to find names.

name: search_illustrations
description: Search unDraw illustrations (MIT licensed, free for commercial use, no attribution required) — full scenes/spot illustrations, a different vocabulary than single-concept UI icons. Returns slugs to pass to get_illustration_svg.

name: get_illustration_svg
description: Returns an unDraw illustration's real SVG source as an editable vector layer (data-layer-kind="svg"), with no external dependency at export time. Use search_illustrations to find slugs.

name: resolve_icon_hints
description:
Swaps every
placeholder in the given HTML for the real Phosphor SVG (same pipeline as insert_icon/image_to_design/import_design). Use this when you're handed raw HTML (e.g. pasted from an external chat) that already follows the icon-hint convention and you need it resolved before applying — does not touch any template, purely a text transform.

html.description: HTML containing zero or more data-icon-hint placeholders

name: create_html_frame
description: Create an HTML frame. For importing designs from Gemini/ChatGPT/Claude (complete HTML+CSS document), use import_design — it's the single-tool entry point that auto-parses documents and handles everything. For editable component designs, create the frame empty and call set_frame_layers. Raw html/css must satisfy the flat editability contract. Position is auto-calculated so frames never overlap.

width.description: Frame width in px (default 1080). Common: 1080 (IG Square), 1920 (Banner)

height.description: Frame height in px (default 1080). Common: 1080 (IG Square), 1920 (Story)

frameStrategy.description: 'multi' = one design per frame (social, print, ads). 'single-web' = one long frame for a web page with sections inside. Auto-detected from dimensions if omitted.

allowGroupedLayers.description: Allow intentional group/container/component layers in raw HTML. Default false.

name: update_html_frame
description: Update an HTML frame's metadata or raw HTML/CSS. For importing complete designs (from Gemini, etc.), use import_design instead — it handles both new frames and existing frame updates in one call. For editable component designs, use set_frame_layers. Raw HTML must use flat sibling layers with data-layer-id/name/kind and explicit position/left/top; accidental groups are rejected before persistence.

allowGroupedLayers.description: Allow intentional group/container/component layers in raw HTML. Default false.

name: delete_html_frame
description: Delete an HTML frame from a template. Cannot delete the last remaining frame.

name: get_html_frames
description: List all HTML frames in a template with their HTML/CSS content, dimensions, and positions.

name: draw_shape
description: Draw a shape with exact dimensions at a specific position. Supports: rect, circle, triangle, star (5-point), polygon (with configurable sides). Triangle uses CSS clip-path. Star and polygon use SVG elements.

sides.description: Number of sides for polygon (default 6), ignored for other types

name: draw_path
description: Create an SVG path element (pen/line drawing). Accepts SVG path data string and bounding box dimensions.

name: transform_element
description: Transform (resize/reposition) an existing element by its data-layer-id. Updates CSS properties for position, width, height, and optionally rotation.

name: group_elements
description: Group multiple elements inside a wrapper div. The wrapper gets a new data-layer-id and the children keep their own ids.

elementIds.description: Array of element data-layer-ids to group

groupName.description: Optional name/class for the group wrapper

name: align_elements
description: Align multiple elements along an axis. Supports left/center/right (horizontal) and top/middle/bottom (vertical) alignment.

elementIds.description: Array of element data-layer-ids to align

bounds.description: Optional rendered geometry in frame coordinates. Supply this when the caller can measure the DOM: an auto-sized element carries no width/height in the stylesheet, and right/centre alignment needs its real box. Omitted, the stylesheet is used.

frameWidth.description: Frame width, used when a single element aligns against its frame

frameHeight.description: Frame height, used when a single element aligns against its frame

name: set_paint
description: Set a layer's FILL and/or STROKE. This is the only way to colour a layer: a layer has two paints and no background. The right CSS property is chosen for you — background-color on a div, fill on an SVG shape, color on a text — so you never name it yourself. On a GROUP the paint reaches every object inside it, because a group paints nothing of its own; painting a box behind a group is not something this editor can express.

elementId.description: data-layer-id of the layer to paint

fill.description: Colour for the layer's interior, e.g. '#3B82F6'. On a group, every object inside it is filled.

strokeWidth.description: Outline thickness; a bare number is read as px. 0 removes the outline.

name: draw_bezier
description: Create an SVG path with cubic (C) or quadratic (Q) bezier curves. Supports smooth curves (S, T), absolute arcs (A), and combined commands. Returns the layer-id of the created path element.

pathData.description: SVG path data with bezier commands (C, Q, S, T, A, M, L, Z)

closed.description: Add Z at the end to close the path (default false)

name: edit_path_points
description: Edit the d-attribute (path data) of an existing SVG path element. Use to move, add, or remove points in a path. Returns the updated path data.

elementId.description: data-layer-id of the SVG path element

newPathData.description: New SVG path d-attribute value. Replaces the existing d value entirely.

name: create_mask_from_path
description: Turn a CLOSED SVG path into a non-destructive mask over an layer. The path stays the editable source of truth (tagged data-mask-for/data-mask-mode; edit_path_points re-bakes automatically). mode 'include' clips the image to inside the path (exterior removed); 'exclude' hides the inside and keeps the exterior. Give pathElementId of an existing path layer (from draw_bezier), or raw pathData in frame coordinates to create the layer on the fly.

pathElementId.description: data-layer-id of an existing SVG path layer (e.g. from draw_bezier)

pathData.description: Raw closed path d in FRAME coordinates, when the path layer does not exist yet (Z closes it if missing)

x.description: With pathData: bbox X in frame coordinates (defaults to the path's own bounds)

y.description: With pathData: bbox Y in frame coordinates

width.description: With pathData: bbox width in frame coordinates

height.description: With pathData: bbox height in frame coordinates

targetImageLayerId.description: data-layer-id of the layer to mask

mode.description: include = keep inside the path (default); exclude = keep the outside

name: invert_mask
description: Flip an existing path mask on an image: include becomes exclude and vice versa (the CSS re-bakes between clip-path and an inverted SVG mask). The image's pixels are never touched.

name: fill_mask
description: Fill the masked subject of an image with a colour: the image gets an exclude mask (the subject becomes a hole) and a div clipped to the subject shape is placed behind it, painted with the fill colour or gradient. Delete that div layer to remove the fill.

fill.description: CSS colour or gradient for the fill, e.g. '#3B82F6' or 'linear-gradient(90deg, #f00, #00f)' (default #3B82F6)

name: mask_brush
description: F4: paint non-destructive brush strokes on an image's mask. Each stroke is a trail of points in IMAGE-LOCAL px (0,0 = the img layer's top-left corner), a brush size and a mode (erase = black = remove, restore = white = bring back). Strokes accumulate in data-mask-brushes on the img and bake into a self-contained data-URI mask; calling again with more strokes edits non-destructively. If the image has no mask yet, a full-rect include mask is created automatically. Editing the mask path with edit_path_points re-bakes the strokes too.

mode.description: erase subtracts from the mask (black), restore brings pixels back (white). Default erase.

name: remove_background
description: Remove the background of an image with u2netp (local ONNX, zero LLM tokens): the result is a PNG with alpha (cutoutUrl) plus a mask PNG and a traced SVG path. Give assetId (a workspace asset) or a direct url. Dispatches a background job and polls ~8s; u2netp usually finishes in 1-3s warm. If the job is still running you get a jobId — poll it with segment_status(jobId). With applyTo {templateId, frameId, layerId} the target layer's src is swapped to the cutout (original kept in data-orig-src). Idempotent per asset: re-running returns the existing cutout.

assetId.description: Workspace asset id to segment (preferred: enables idempotency)

url.description: Direct image URL (http/https). Use when there is no workspace asset yet.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (optional when assetId is given — derived from the asset)

applyTo.description: Optional: apply the cutout to an existing image layer

layerId.description: data-layer-id of the layer to swap

name: segment_status
description: Poll a segmentation job by id (remove_background / segment_click / segment_text). Done jobs carry result_json: cutoutUrl (PNG alpha), maskUrl, svgPath (boundary trace with bbox), image dims.

jobId.description: Job id returned by remove_background or segment_click

name: segment_click
description: Segment an image with MobileSAM from click prompts or CLIPSeg from a text prompt (local ONNX, zero LLM tokens): every point runs through ONE encoder pass, and the mask comes back as a cutout PNG (alpha), a mask PNG and a traced SVG path (dNorm normalized 0..1 over the image). Points: x/y either normalized 0..1 or px with imageWidth/imageHeight; neg=true marks a background point (Alt+click in the UI). prompt (e.g. "la persona") runs CLIPSeg text mode instead and takes precedence over points/box. Dispatches a background job and polls ~8s; if it is still running you get a jobId — poll it with segment_status(jobId). With applyTo {templateId, frameId, layerId} the traced mask is applied to the target layer as a non-destructive mask path (F1 mechanism: editable with edit_path_points, re-bakes).

url.description: Direct image URL (http/https). Use when there is no workspace asset yet.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (optional when assetId is given — derived from the asset)

points.description: SAM click prompts: x/y normalized 0..1 over the image (or px + imageWidth/imageHeight); neg=true = background (Alt+click)

box.description: Optional SAM box prompt {x,y,w,h} normalized 0..1 (or px + imageWidth/imageHeight)

prompt.description: Optional CLIPSeg text prompt (e.g. "la persona", "the red car"). Runs segment_text instead of SAM clicks and takes precedence over points/box.

imageWidth.description: Source image px width — required when points/box are given in px instead of 0..1

imageHeight.description: Source image px height — required when points/box are given in px instead of 0..1

applyTo.description: Optional: apply the traced mask to an existing image layer as a non-destructive mask path

layerId.description: data-layer-id of the layer to mask

name: edit_path_point
description: Incrementally edit a single point in an SVG path. Move a point by index, toggle smooth/corner, delete a point, or insert a new point. No need to regenerate the full d-attribute.

pointIndex.description: 0-based index of the point to edit. Required for move/delete/toggle.

type.description: Toggle point type between anchor (corner) and smooth (bezier)

action.description: Action: move (default), delete, or toggle smooth/corner

insertAfterIndex.description: Insert a new anchor point after this index (requires x, y)

name: shape_to_path
description: Convert a CSS-based shape (rect div with border-radius, circle div) to an SVG path element so it can participate in pathfinder boolean operations and point editing.

elementId.description: data-layer-id of the CSS shape to convert

name: generate_ui_components
description: Generate a standardized UI component kit (buttons, cards, nav, forms, hero) from the current design system tokens. Each component is an editable frame element using CSS custom properties from the brand.

templateId.description: Source template for design system extraction

targetFrameId.description: Frame to add components to (uses first frame if omitted)

name: pathfinder
description: Perform boolean operations (union, subtract, intersect, exclude) on two SVG path elements. Creates a new merged SVG element and removes the originals.

elementIdA.description: data-layer-id of the first SVG element

elementIdB.description: data-layer-id of the second SVG element

name: upload_image
description: Upload an image (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP) to the design-assets bucket. Accepts base64 data or external URL. Returns asset record with public URL.

url.description: External image URL to download and store

name: list_assets
description: List all uploaded assets with optional workspace and search filters

name: delete_asset
description: Delete an asset from storage and database

name: list_recipes
description: List all saved recipes (key visuals) with optional workspace and search filters

name: get_recipe
description: Get a single recipe by ID with full HTML/CSS template data

workspaceId.description: If provided, the recipe must belong to this workspace or the call fails — prevents cross-tenant reads.

name: create_from_recipe
description: Create a new template from a saved recipe, applying optional variable substitutions

name.description: Name for the new template (default: recipe name + timestamp)

variables.description: Variable substitutions: { texts: {KEY: value}, colors: {KEY: value}, images: {KEY: url} }

name: profile_template_pool
description: Profile multiple templates to detect content slots (text, image, richtext, cta), estimate text capacity (maxChars), classify layout type, and compute CSV column schema. Supports data-slot attribute for explicit slot naming. Deterministic — no AI involved.

templateIds.description: Template IDs to profile. Uses the first frame of each template as the source.

frameId.description: Exact frame to profile (id or name, case-insensitive). REQUIRED when the template has multiple frames; auto-used when it has exactly one.

frameName.description: Alias of frameId — the human frame name.

name: generate_csv_template
description: Generate a CSV template with columns matching profiled slots across a template pool. Includes _template column with immutable templateId values and human-readable names in comments. Ready for Excel/Sheets. Deterministic.

rowCount.description: Number of empty data rows to generate (default 1)

frameId.description: Exact frame to build the CSV from (id or name, case-insensitive). REQUIRED when the template has multiple frames; auto-used when it has exactly one.

frameName.description: Alias of frameId — the human frame name.

name: apply_csv_to_frames
description: Apply CSV data to generate frames from a template pool. Each row becomes a frame in a NEW output template. The system duplicates the chosen template and fills slots with CSV values. Empty cells are skipped. Deterministic — no AI content generation, no summarization. Returns per-row report.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID where the output template will be created

csvData.description: Raw CSV content as string (with header row, _template column required)

templateIds.description: Template IDs in the pool. First frame of each is used as the source.

outputName.description: Name for the output template. Default: 'Batch Export — YYYY-MM-DD'

naming.description: Frame naming template. Use {index} and column names in braces. Example: 'Post {index} — {titulo}'

onMissingTemplate.description: What to do if _template value is not in the pool (default 'error')

onOverflow.description: What to do if text exceeds slot maxChars (default 'truncate')

frameId.description: Exact frame to apply CSV rows onto (id or name, case-insensitive). REQUIRED when the template has multiple frames; auto-used when it has exactly one.

frameName.description: Alias of frameId — the human frame name.

name: list_batch_templates
description: List all templates that contain {{slot}} placeholders or data-slot attributes — i.e. templates ready for CSV batch generation. Returns template ID, name, slot count, and slot names. Use to discover which templates can be used with apply_csv_to_frames or the REST batch API.

name: lock_element
description: Lock or unlock a layer/element in a frame. Locked elements cannot be selected or moved on the canvas (pointer-events: none).

layerId.description: Layer ID (data-layer-id attribute) of the element to lock/unlock

locked.description: true to lock, false to unlock

name: hide_element
description: Hide or show a layer/element in a frame. Hidden elements get display:none and are invisible on the canvas.

layerId.description: Layer ID (data-layer-id attribute) of the element to hide/show

hidden.description: true to hide, false to show

name: edit_text_content
description: Change text by data-layer-id. Pass frameId for text inside a frame; omit it for a root canvas object whose persisted frameId is null.

frameId.description: Frame ID containing the text element. Omit for a root canvas object.

layerId.description: Layer ID (data-layer-id attribute) of the text element

name: list_all_texts
description: Extract ALL text content from design frames and root canvas objects. Root objects return frameId=null so the data table can distinguish them without adding a visible label in Layers. Auto-tags missing layer IDs and returns template, frame/location, brand, and campaign metadata.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to scan. May be omitted only when templateId is supplied.

templateId.description: Filter to a single template. If omitted, scans all (max 100).

frameId.description: Filter to a single frame within the template(s).

includeEmpty.description: Include elements with no text content (default false).

name: copy_style
description: Copy all CSS properties from one element. Returns the CSS declarations as a string that can be pasted onto another element.

frameId.description: Frame ID containing the source element

layerId.description: Layer ID (data-layer-id attribute) of the element to copy from

name: paste_style
description: Apply copied CSS properties to a target element. Merges the provided style declarations into the element's existing CSS rule. A layer has a fill and a stroke and no background: set_paint picks the right property for you (background-color on a div, fill on an SVG shape, color on a text) and on a group paints every object inside rather than a box behind them.

frameId.description: Frame ID containing the target element

layerId.description: Layer ID (data-layer-id attribute) of the element to paste onto

styles.description: CSS declarations string to apply (e.g. 'color: red; font-size: 16px;')

name: set_pseudo_state
description: Set CSS pseudo-class styles (:hover, :active, :focus) for an element. Creates or updates a pseudo-class CSS rule like '.class:hover { ... }'.

layerId.description: Layer ID (data-layer-id attribute) of the element

styles.description: CSS declarations to apply in the pseudo state (e.g. 'background-color: #333; transform: scale(1.05);')

name: create_brand_guideline
description: Create a new brand guideline. Automatically creates a Design System template file (is_brand_manual=true) for the brand. Use this to create a brand from scratch; to extract styles from a design, prefer generate_design_artifacts(action: 'publish').

description.description: Optional description of the brand identity

tokensJson.description: JSON string of extracted design tokens

sharedCss.description: Shared CSS variables and utility classes

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 hash of source frames for staleness detection

sourceTemplateIds.description: Template IDs that contribute styles to this brand. Optional for brand creation; required for style extraction.

name: get_brand_guideline
description: Retrieve a brand guideline by ID. Returns the full record including tokensJson, designMd, and sharedCss. Use this to load a brand's design system for use in an agent workflow.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID that owns the style

name: list_brand_guidelines
description: List brand guideline summaries in a workspace. Artifacts are omitted by default to protect agent context. Set includeDeleted=true to see trashed brands. After discovery, prefer get_brand_guideline for one exact style.

includeArtifacts.description: Include full tokensJson, designMd and sharedCss documents. Default false.

includeDeleted.description: Include soft-deleted brands in trash. Default false (active brands only).

name: update_brand_guideline
description: Update an existing brand guideline's content. Use this to refresh design tokens, update documentation, or modify shared CSS after design changes.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID that owns the style

sourceTemplateIds.description: Updated non-empty source template IDs. Omitting preserves current references.

mode.description: replace (default) overwrites fields. append concatenates tokensJson, designMd, and sharedCss to the end of existing content — useful for incrementally building a brand guideline without reading the current value first.

name: delete_brand_guideline
description: Soft-delete a brand guideline. The brand moves to the trash (deleted_at set) and can be restored. Set cascadeDs=true to also soft-delete the brand's Design System template file. When cascadeDs is false/omitted, the DS template survives as a regular design file under the user's default brand.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID that owns the style

cascadeDs.description: Also soft-delete the Design System template file. Default: false (DS template survives as regular design).

name: restore_brand_guideline
description: Restore a soft-deleted brand guideline from the trash. Also restores the brand's Design System template if it was soft-deleted.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID that owns the style

name: add_frame_to_brand
description: Duplicate a frame from a source template into a brand's Design System template. The source template and frame are NOT modified — a copy is inserted into the DS file. This is the 'click plin' operation: add a design to the Brand Library without altering the original.

sourceTemplateId.description: Template containing the frame to copy

sourceFrameId.description: Frame ID to duplicate from the source template

label.description: Optional label for the copied frame (default: source frame name)

name: apply_brand_to_template
description: Link a template to a brand guideline. Sets the template's brandId and copies the brand's designArtifacts (tokensJson, designMd, sharedCss) onto the template for immediate use. AI agents can then use get_design_artifacts to retrieve brand-aware design data.

templateId.description: Template ID to apply the brand to

name: get_active_styles
description: Retrieve the active (locked) styles for a workspace. When styles are locked, AI agents MUST use these styles for all design work. Returns the locked brand guidelines with their tokens. Call this BEFORE designing anything.

name: set_style_lock
description: Toggle the lock state of a style (brand guideline) in a workspace. When locked, AI agents are instructed to use only that style for designing. Multiple styles can be locked simultaneously.

locked.description: true = lock this style, false = unlock

name: find_duplicate_styles
description: Scan brand guidelines in a workspace and group them by style fingerprint. Returns groups of visually identical styles that can be merged. Use this to detect when multiple brand guidelines share the same design tokens.

name: merge_brand_guidelines
description: Merge multiple brand guidelines into one canonical record. Transfers all sourceTemplateIds from the source brands to the target, then deletes the sources. The target brand retains its ID and gets the combined template references.

targetBrandId.description: The brand ID to keep (receives merged data)

sourceBrandIds.description: Brand IDs from the same workspace to merge into target and then delete

name: download_style_template
description: Returns a DTCG-format tokens JSON template for external AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT). The human fills each $value with data from images/screenshots, then uploads the .json via Style Library → Upload or create_brand_guideline MCP tool. The format is identical to what generateTokensJson() produces, ensuring fingerprint compatibility.

name: set_stroke_style
description: Set stroke properties (color, width, linecap, linejoin, dasharray) on an SVG path element. Applies CSS stroke-* properties to the element's selector.

layerId.description: Layer ID of the SVG path element

name: set_gradient
description: Apply a CSS gradient (linear, radial, conic) to an element's background or fill. For SVG paths, sets fill property; for div elements, sets background-image.

angle.description: Angle in degrees for linear gradient (0=t→b, 90=l→r)

stops.description: Array of {color, position} objects. Position is 0-100 percentage.

name: set_blend_mode
description: Set the CSS mix-blend-mode on an element. Controls how the element blends with its backdrop (multiply, screen, overlay, etc.).

name: outline_stroke
description: Convert an SVG stroke to a filled outline path. Uses svg-path-commander to expand the stroke into a filled shape. Useful for boolean operations and advanced path editing.

frameId.description: Frame ID containing the SVG element

layerId.description: Layer ID of the SVG path element

strokeWidth.description: Stroke width to expand (overrides element's current stroke-width)

name: offset_path
description: Create an offset (inset/outset) version of an SVG path. Positive offset expands outward, negative offset shrinks inward. Uses svg-path-commander pathOffset().

frameId.description: Frame ID containing the SVG element

layerId.description: Layer ID of the SVG path element

offset.description: Offset distance in pixels. Positive=outset, negative=inset.

name: rename_template
description: Rename a template (workspace). Updates the template name in the database.

name: update_thumbnail
description: Set or update the preview thumbnail for a template — call this after creating or substantially changing a design, so its card shows the work instead of a generated placeholder. The capture replaces the design's previous one at a fixed path; there is no thumbnail history, by design. Render at card size (~480px on the long edge), not full artboard resolution.

workspaceId.description: Optional. The storage folder is derived from the template's own workspace, so this is only a fallback — and passing one that disagrees is rejected by the tenancy guard.

thumbnail.description: Base64 data URL (max 1MB as a string) or HTTPS image URL for the thumbnail preview

name: create_api_key
description: Create a workspace-scoped API key for agent access. The raw key is returned once.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the key is restricted to

label.description: Human-readable label for this key (e.g., 'Claude Code', 'OpenClaw')

name: revoke_api_key
description: Revoke an API key by its ID. The key becomes invalid immediately.

keyId.description: ID of the key to revoke

name: list_api_keys
description: List all active API keys. Keys are masked for security (only last 4 chars shown).

name: list_workspace_integrations
description: List enabled MCP and model API connections for a workspace without exposing credentials.

name: call_workspace_mcp
description: Call a tool on an enabled MCP connection owned by this workspace. BYOK credentials stay server-side.

name: get_metrics
description: Get activity metrics aggregated by day. Returns design operations count, frames created, templates created, and breakdown by actor (IA vs human vs system). Useful for activity calendars and dashboards.

from.description: Start date (ISO format, default 30 days ago)

name: tag_template
description: Add one or more tags to a template. Tags use format 'prefix:value' (e.g., 'brand:futuraria', 'tema:navidad', 'formato:story'). Tags enable the design graph and find_templates.

tags.description: Array of tag strings to add (e.g., ['brand:acme', 'formato:post'])

name: untag_template
description: Remove one or more tags from a template.

tags.description: Array of tag strings to remove

name: find_templates
description: Find templates by tags (exact match) and optional workspace filter. Pass similarTo with a template ID to sort results by style similarity. This is the core query for the design graph.

tags.description: Tags to match (templates must have ALL specified tags)

similarTo.description: Optional template ID to rank results by similarity (higher score = more similar)

name: get_file_meta
description: Get curated metadata for a template: brand, tags, theme, format, file_type, cover_image_url, obsidian_link. Returns null if no metadata has been set yet for this template.

name: set_file_meta
description: Set or update metadata for a template (upsert). Accepts any subset of fields: brand, tags, theme, format, file_type, cover_image_url, obsidian_link. Only provided fields are updated.

theme.description: Visual theme, e.g. corporate, minimal, brutalist

cover_image_url.description: Custom cover image URL (Supabase Storage public URL)

name: query_design_graph
description: Query the design knowledge graph. Returns nodes (templates with metadata) and edges (connections via shared brand/tags). Filter by workspace, brand, tag, or format to explore design patterns.

tag.description: Filter by tag (templates containing this tag)

name: upload_cover_image
description: Upload a cover image (PNG/JPEG base64, max 1MB) for a template. Stored in Supabase Storage design-covers bucket. Returns the public URL.

name: get_playbook
description: Retrieve a full graph-playbook by name. Call this after seeing the playbook index in the initialize response or get_agent_guide. Returns the complete markdown content of the playbook with DAG diagrams, node contracts, phase-by-phase tool guides, validation gates, error recovery paths, and copy-paste MCP call sequences.

name: import_design
description: Import a complete design from HTML+CSS (from Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, or any AI). This is the ONE tool for importing designs — handles both combined document and separate html/css. Accepts EITHER a 'document' field (complete HTML with inline

frameId.description: Optional. Existing frame ID to update. If omitted, a new frame is auto-created.

document.description: Complete HTML document (with <style> tags, <body> content, font @import links). Auto-parsed: <style> → CSS, <body> → HTML, <link> fonts → @import.

html.description: HTML body content (use when you have html and css separately). Ignored if 'document' is provided.

css.description: CSS stylesheet (use when you have html and css separately). Ignored if 'document' is provided.

name.description: Frame name (only used when creating a new frame). Default: 'Imported Design'.

width.description: Frame width in px. Auto-detected from CSS body { width } if omitted. Default 1080.

height.description: Frame height in px. Auto-detected from CSS body { height } if omitted. Default 1080.

frameStrategy.description: 'multi' = one design per frame. 'single-web' = one long frame for a web page.

name: get_agent_guide
description: Get the agent onboarding guide — a summary of how to work with Futuraria MCP effectively. Call this as your second step after initialize. Returns: connection info, auth details, quick tool reference, playbook index, creative vs editable mode guide, memory instructions, and a 3-step getting-started checklist.

name: verify_api_key
description: PUBLIC TOOL (no auth required). Check if an API key is valid and get a full diagnostic. Use this when authentication fails with 401 to find out WHY: key_not_found, key_revoked, key_expired, database_error, etc. Pass the same key you would send in the x-api-key header. Clients that cannot send headers (e.g. Claude Connectors) can append ?key=YOUR_KEY to the MCP URL instead — the server reads both.

name: studio_create_card
description: Create a design task card in the Studio Board (Kanban). Each card represents a design to be produced: banner, post, deck, landing, etc. The card tracks status through the pipeline: pending -> in_progress -> review -> done. Use this when you need to track a design task.

brandId.description: Brand guideline ID — pre-resolved by leader. The implementer uses this directly without lookup.

styleName.description: Human-readable style name (e.g. 'Futuraria_Infographic'). Paired with brandId so the card carries full context.

templateId.description: Template ID if editing an existing design (optional — omit for new designs)

frameCount.description: Exact number of frames to create. Pre-resolved by leader so implementer doesn't guess.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria — objective verifiable items. The reviewer checks each one. Example: ['Button exists in topbar', 'Build passes without TS errors']

source.description: Provenance: mcp (via external AI/MCP call), chat_internal (via the in-app chat), or human (manually created)

aiModel.description: AI model that created this task (e.g. claude-sonnet-4, gpt-4o). Omit for human-created tasks.

name: studio_list_cards
description: List design task cards from the Studio Board. Filter by workspace, brand, status, priority, or assigned person. Returns cards sorted by priority then deadline.

name: studio_move_card
description: Move a design task card to a new status in the Studio Board. Use this to progress cards through the pipeline: backlog -> research -> draft -> design -> review -> done, or send back to feedback.

comment.description: Optional comment explaining the status change

name: studio_get_card
description: Get full details of a single design task card, including activity log of all status transitions.

name: studio_update_card
description: Update fields of a Kanban card. Whitelisted fields only: title, brief, tone, cta, priority, deadline, status, type, format, frame_count, tags, acceptance, assigned_to, brand_id, style_name, template_id, source, ai_model, content_type, enabled. The enabled boolean controls whether the Musa daily batch (scheduled function musa-batch) processes the card.

aiModel.description: AI model to use for this card

enabled.description: If false, the Musa daily batch skips this card

comment.description: Optional activity log comment when status changes

name: studio_delete_card
description: Delete a Kanban card together with its activity log and agent time rows. Irreversible — the card disappears from the board and the batch immediately.

name: studio_log_agent_time
description: Log time, tokens, and model usage for an agent session on a Kanban task. Accumulates totals on the card and calculates cost from the deterministic ai_model_pricing table. Call this when an agent (leader/implementer/reviewer) finishes work on a task.

taskId.description: Card ID to log time against

aiModel.description: AI model used (e.g. claude-sonnet-4). Used for cost lookup.

name: studio_list_models
description: List all AI models and their pricing from the deterministic lookup table. Returns model name, provider, and per-1M-token input/output prices. Use this to see available models and their costs.

name: harness_get_context
description: Bootstrap context for an agent session. Returns the agent definition (labor + protocol + hard_rules), and when workspaceId is provided: active styles, brand guidelines, and recent templates. Use this BEFORE doing any work — it replaces reading many files. For the leader, this is step 0 and returns everything needed for context validation (step 0.5).

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID — when provided, returns active styles, brands, and templates for this workspace

taskId.description: Optional task to include its acceptance criteria

sessionId.description: Optional session to include its latest entries

name: harness_list_features
description: List Kanban tasks eligible for work (the cloud equivalent of feature_list.json). Returns pending tasks with acceptance criteria. The leader picks ONE. Filtering by status is supported — defaults to backlog.

name: harness_claim_feature
description: Atomically claim a task for this agent. Sets status to 'draft' (in_progress). Fails with code -32000 if there is already an active task for the account (hard rule: only ONE in_progress at a time per account, mirroring init.sh's check). On success, returns the full task with acceptance.

name: harness_release_feature
description: Release the lock on a claimed task (set to 'feedback' or 'backlog'). Use when blocked or pausing.

name: harness_start_session
description: Start a new harness session for an agent working on a task. Returns a minimal context_summary built from the agent definition + acceptance + recent entries — subagents get only what they need (anti-context-degradation).

name: harness_log_entry
description: Append to the bitácora (anti-teléfono-descompuesto). Subagents write results HERE, not in chat. The leader reads references, not content. Every meaningful step should be logged: plan, progress, blocker, exploration, verdict.

promptUsed.description: Prompt that produced this result (for harness auto-improvement)

name: harness_dump_context
description: Extract current context (decisions, learnings, state) into harness_entries as a context_dump. Frees the context window. The next agent (or next session of the same agent) reads it via harness_get_context. Critical for >40% context usage.

content.description: Markdown summary of what to remember

name: harness_get_entries
description: Read bitácora entries for a session. Used by reviewers to audit implementer work, and by leaders to recover context after a flush. Returns entries in reverse chronological order.

name: harness_healthcheck
description: Cloud equivalent of init.sh. Verifies: (1) MCP reachable, (2) Supabase reachable, (3) harness tables exist, (4) design_kanban_tasks reachable, (5) optional lint_design on a template. Returns ok: true|false and per-check details. The reviewer MUST call this before approving.

templateId.description: Optional template to lint_design as part of the check

name: harness_evaluate_checkpoint
description: Record pass/fail for a checkpoint (C1-C5) on a task. Reviewer calls this once per checkpoint while reviewing. Implementation stores result in harness_checkpoints AND in design_kanban_tasks.checkpoint_json.

sessionId.description: Active reviewer session for this task

name: harness_submit_for_review
description: Implementer signals work is ready for review. Sets task status to 'review' and logs the submission. The leader then launches a reviewer.

name: harness_complete_feature
description: Reviewer-only completion gate. Requires an active reviewer session, a real harness_submit_for_review marker from the implementer, and fresh passing C1-C5 checkpoints.

sessionId.description: Active reviewer session that evaluated C1-C5

name: harness_record_runtime_event
description: Append one sanitized, idempotent runtime transition for a harness session. Never send prompts, tool arguments, HTML/CSS, or credentials.

name: harness_get_runtime_events
description: Read sanitized runtime events for one authorized session using a monotonic cursor.

name: harness_list_sessions
description: List authorized harness sessions for a task, optionally filtered by status.

name: harness_finish_session
description: CAS-close an active/paused session. completed is reviewer-only; implementers must call harness_submit_for_review so the review-cycle marker is recorded.

status.description: completed is accepted only for reviewer sessions

name: harness_list_cronjobs
description: List scheduled cronjobs for the account. Returns enabled and disabled jobs with their schedule, last_run_at, and next_run_at.

enabledOnly.description: If true, return only enabled cronjobs (default: false)

name: harness_create_cronjob
description: Create a scheduled cronjob that auto-creates and processes tasks. Requires a cron schedule, a task template, and the account's fdr_ws_ api key (stored encrypted_api_key) so the cron runner can authenticate to MCP.

schedule.description: 5-field cron expression, e.g. '0 6 * * *' for daily at 6am

encryptedApiKey.description: Account's fdr_ws_ API key — used by the cron runner to call MCP on the account's behalf

name: harness_toggle_cronjob
description: Enable, disable, or delete a cronjob.

name: harness_report_error
description: Registra un error en Supabase (harness_error_logs) para análisis interno. Usar cuando cualquier tool falle.

tool.description: Nombre de la tool que falló

args.description: Argumentos con los que se llamó

name: harness_list_errors
description: Retrieve recent error logs from harness_error_logs. Use after a cascade to see what actually failed and why.

name: comment_add
description: Add a comment pin on the canvas. Auto-creates a Kanban task unless createKanbanTask is false. When the template is a Brand Manual (is_brand_manual=true), comment_type defaults to 'documentation' instead of 'feedback'.

xPct.description: X position in frame as percentage 0-100

yPct.description: Y position in frame as percentage 0-100

commentType.description: Comment type. Defaults to 'documentation' for Brand Manual templates, 'feedback' otherwise.

createKanbanTask.description: If true (default), also creates a Kanban task

parentId.description: Parent comment ID for threaded replies

name: comment_list
description: List comments for a template, optionally filtered by frame and status.

name: comment_resolve
description: Mark a comment as resolved.

name: comment_reply
description: Reply to an existing comment (threading).

name: vectorize_image
description: Convert a raster image (base64 or URL) into an editable SVG vector using Quiver AI. Inserts the result as a vector layer (data-layer-kind="svg") in the specified frame. Requires a Quiver API key configured in AI Settings (server-side encrypted). Non-streaming — returns the final SVG directly.

templateId.description: Template ID to inject the SVG into

frameId.description: Optional frame ID. If omitted, writes to the first frame.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded image data (data:image/...;base64,...). Either this or imageUrl is required.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the image to vectorize. Used if imageBase64 is not provided.

autoCrop.description: Automatically detect and crop to the main subject (default: true)

targetSize.description: Target SVG viewport size, e.g. '1024x1024' (default: original image size)

x.description: Absolute X position in px for the inserted SVG (default: 0)

y.description: Absolute Y position in px for the inserted SVG (default: 0)

model.description: Quiver model ID (default: arrow-1.1). Options: arrow-1.1, arrow-1.1-max

name: generate_svg
description: Generate SVG vector art from a text prompt using Quiver AI. Inserts the result as a vector layer (data-layer-kind="svg") in the specified frame. Requires a Quiver API key configured in AI Settings (server-side encrypted). Non-streaming — returns the final SVG(s) directly.

templateId.description: Template ID to inject the SVG into

prompt.description: Text description of the SVG to generate (e.g. 'a minimalist unicorn icon')

instructions.description: Optional style guidance (e.g. 'flat design, single color, rounded corners')

n.description: Number of variations to generate (1-4, default: 1). The first is auto-inserted.

model.description: Quiver model ID (default: arrow-1.1). Options: arrow-1.1, arrow-1.1-max

x.description: Absolute X position in px for the inserted SVG (default: 50)

y.description: Absolute Y position in px for the inserted SVG (default: 50)

name: task_queue_add
description: DEPRECATED: creates a Kanban card (design_kanban_tasks) in backlog instead of a task_queue row. The Musa daily batch (scheduled function musa-batch, 9 UTC) processes Kanban cards by status. Prefer studio_create_card for new work.

name.description: Template name for the generated design

name: task_queue_list
description: DEPRECATED: returns Kanban cards (design_kanban_tasks) instead of task_queue rows. Prefer studio_list_cards, which also groups by status column.

status.description: Filter by status: pending, processing, done, failed

name: task_queue_get_config
description: Read the automation configuration for a workspace. Returns auto_process_enabled, provider, limits, and notification settings. Use this to load the initial toggle state in the UI.

name: task_queue_update_config
description: Create or update the automation configuration for a workspace. Used to toggle auto-processing on/off and configure provider and limits. Merge semantics (v27): only sent fields are written, the rest keep their current DB values — the Configuración panel saves the Automatización card and the Kanban card independently. No schedule field: the global daily cron processes every enabled workspace on each run.

notifyOnComplete.description: Send Telegram notification when batch finishes

batchLlmProvider.description: LLM provider: deepseek, openai, anthropic (default: deepseek). The API key is resolved per-user via BYOK.

kanbanAutoRefresh.description: Enable/disable the Kanban auto-refresh poll (Configuración → Kanban). The poll only fires while the tab is visible.

kanbanPollSeconds.description: Kanban auto-refresh interval in seconds: 15, 30, 60 or 120 (default: 30).

name: platform_get_status
description: PLATFORM TOOL (admin key or workspace owner only). Read platform-level switches and limits: musa_tick_enabled (hourly batch dispatcher kill switch, stored in platform_config, migration v27) and monthly_mcp_quota (per-workspace MCP calls/month, 0 = unlimited). Also reports whether the env-level MUSA_TICK_ENABLED=false emergency override is active (it wins over the DB switch).

name: platform_update_config
description: PLATFORM TOOL (admin key or workspace owner only). Update platform-level switches and limits. musaTickEnabled=false stops the hourly musa-batch-tick from dispatching the batch (the manual 'Ejecutar batch' button in the Kanban keeps working). monthlyMcpQuota sets the per-workspace monthly MCP call quota (0 = unlimited, default: 5000); it takes effect immediately. Idempotent; only provided fields change.

musaTickEnabled.description: Enable/disable the hourly Musa batch dispatcher (musa-batch-tick)

monthlyMcpQuota.description: Per-workspace monthly MCP call quota. 0 = unlimited (default: 5000)

name: process_daily_batch
description: Dry-run preview of the Musa batch. The real pipeline runs in the musa-batch BACKGROUND function (netlify.toml), dispatched hourly by the musa-batch-tick scheduled function and on demand by musa_batch_run; it advances every enabled Kanban card one step (leader/implementer/reviewer). This sync method only supports dryRun:true (no LLM cost). To actually RUN the batch now, call musa_batch_run instead.

workspaceId.description: Optional: limit the batch to a single workspace ID.

dryRun.description: Optional: if true, only list what would be processed without generating.

name: musa_batch_run
description: One-click trigger: dispatch the Musa batch for a workspace NOW instead of waiting for the hourly tick. Validates the dispatch to the musa-batch BACKGROUND function (Netlify 202 = accepted) and returns { started: true } immediately — the leader/implementer/reviewer pipeline then runs in background for up to 15 min (watch the Kanban cards advance). A failed dispatch returns started:false with the real error. Non-admin callers can only trigger their own workspace (workspaceId is validated/forced). With dryRun:true it instead awaits and returns the full dry-run preview inline (no LLM cost).

workspaceId.description: Workspace to process. Non-admin callers: only their own workspace (server-resolved if omitted). Admin may omit it to run every enabled workspace.

dryRun.description: If true, await and return the dry-run preview (what each card would run) without LLM cost.

name: list_calendar_entries
description: List content_calendar entries — the single table behind the Calendario, Contenidos and Reportes views. Filter by date window (from/to, YYYY-MM-DD), status (idea|diseño|aprobación|programado|publicado) and kind (organic|ad). Use it to see what is already planned before adding ideas, or to find entries whose copy is still empty (an idea without copy is the normal state of a raw idea).

workspaceId.description: Workspace (auto-resolved from the API key when omitted)

status.description: Filter: idea | diseño | aprobación | programado | publicado

name: add_content_idea
description: Add a content IDEA to the calendar: a content_calendar row with status='idea' and empty copy. Requires scheduledDate (YYYY-MM-DD) and topic; channels/kind/campaign/notes optional. The idea shows up in Calendario and Contenidos immediately. Draft the actual copy later with update_content, following the workspace's copy recipes (list_copy_recipes).

workspaceId.description: Target workspace (auto-resolved from the API key)

topic.description: What the piece is about — required; an idea without a topic cannot be found later

copy.description: Optional draft already written. Omit for a pure idea (empty copy is normal).

brandId.description: Optional brand id from the workspace

name: update_content
description: Update a calendar entry by id: write the copy, change topic/date/time/channels/campaign, attach a design (templateId or externalUrl) or move the status along idea → diseño → aprobación → programado → publicado. Writing copy is what turns a raw idea into drafted content; an empty copy string clears the draft back to a bare idea.

copy.description: The caption/copy itself. Draft it following the workspace copy recipes (list_copy_recipes).

templateId.description: Attach a design file from this workspace

name: delete_content
description: Delete a calendar entry (idea or content) by id.

name: list_copy_recipes
description: List the workspace WRITING recipes: hooks, communication tones and copywriting frameworks (AIDA, PAS, StoryBrand…) saved by the user or by AIs. Read them BEFORE drafting a copy so it follows the user's voice, and mention which recipes you applied. These are copy_recipes (instructional text) — for design recipes / key visuals use list_recipes instead.

name: create_copy_recipe
description: Create a writing recipe in the workspace library (type: hook | tono | framework | otro). Humans and AIs share this exact CRUD — when the user asks you to research frameworks/hooks online and save them for future copies, this is the tool. Keep content self-contained: instructions + one worked example, so any AI can apply it later without extra context.

workspaceId.description: Target workspace (auto-resolved from the API key)

content.description: The recipe itself: structure, rules and one worked example

source.description: humano | ia (informational provenance; MCP calls default to ia)

name: update_copy_recipe
description: Update an existing writing recipe (name, content, type or tags) by id.

name: delete_copy_recipe
description: Delete a writing recipe by id.
